content: {"paper_id":"W2214660060","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Multilabel classification is a central problem in many areas of data analysis, including text and multimedia categorization, where individual data objects need to be assigned multiple labels.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要以多标记分类为核心问题，并明确单个对象需被赋予多个标签，符合多标记学习的任务定义。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"We furthermore show how covariances between the label models can be learned simultaneously with the classification model itself","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要说明标签模型之间的协方差可与分类模型联合学习，即显式建模标签间的相关/依赖结构。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
